derivation:
by
  change Submodule.span (locRing B x) (locMap x M '' (N : Set _)) = _
  exact (Submodule.localized'_eq_span (locRing B x) x.asIdeal.primeCompl (locMap x M) N).symm
explanation: Mathlib identifies a localized submodule with the span of its image. Instantiate this with the local ring and locMap; unfolding lineBaseChange gives that span. The existing proof explicitly uses this declaration.
